Intelligent Research Assistant
Project Report
1.3
Proposed Solution
The Intelligent Research Assistant solves these problems by utilizing Retrieval-Augmented
Generation (RAG). In a RAG architecture, the LLM is not expected to know the an-
swer from its internal weights. Instead, when a user asks a question, the system first
retrieves the most relevant paragraphs from the user’s uploaded documents using dense
vector embeddings. These paragraphs are then injected into the prompt of a localized
LLM, restricting the LLM to only formulate an answer based on the provided text.
This approach guarantees data privacy (since everything can be run locally or on
trusted private servers) and virtually eliminates hallucinations, as the LLM is forced to
cite the exact chunks of text it used to generate the answer.
